reviews.text: Large selection, friendly service, reasonable prices, I recommend it! Easily accessible, not far from the Árpád Bridge.
Wide selection, good prices, fast delivery. I like it.
They are kind, helpful, and one of the best in terms of selection and price! We love going to them!
I received my order quickly and accurately. Thank you!

I order from them often
And so far I'm satisfied with everything
If there is a change or something is out of stock, they are happy to write or call and solve it right away..
They also have a huge selection
The 🐰 is always happy and excited when the new one arrives 📦
I can only recommend them to all owners
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
Super knowledgeable, friendly staff. Very good prices
There is a good selection of degu (and other rodent) food. The "Reform" brand is very reasonably priced!

I bought a pet carrier for my bike and overall I am satisfied with it. The product is suitable, stable to use, and fully meets its purpose. During assembly, I noticed that one of the stiffeners was a little bent, but I was able to fix it easily. I also added an extra attachment, so it became even stronger and more stable.

It seems safe in use, it can be easily attached to the bike, and the animal fits comfortably in it. It is also excellent for market shopping, it can be packed well.

Overall, I recommend it 👍
By far the best shop for bunnies in Budapest. The salespeople are nice, know the products and are super friendly.
The order is fulfilled quickly, the price of the ordered product is fair, and the customer is satisfied.

I called the store to inquire, introduced myself kindly, wished them a nice day, and then asked if they considered it an Emperor Scorpion.... then the lady interrupted me without even waiting for the end of the sentence, saying 'nothing' and then hung up the phone on me :) really nice staff :)
